meaning:
§ Eshtemoa = "I will make myself heard" Eshtemoh = "I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft"
a Levitical city in Judah

renderings.kjv: and to them which were in Eshtemoa

elsewhere.note: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,
The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and she bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
